findings.observation: The exact request parameter set has no models selector and native provenance records model_selection as automatic_best_match.
The workload coverage authority is global and does not bind targets to a model-specific numerical domain.

The fixed selector icon_eu is documented for Europe, while the current authority admits globally valid latitude and longitude values; the cited official model documentation supplies no canonical numerical polygon or bounding box that closes that mismatch.

The current 19-variable profile requests lightning_potential, which the model-specific documentation identifies as ICON-D2-only, and precipitation_probability has ensemble lineage rather than a single deterministic ICON-EU source.
The cited model-specific documentation does not establish the current lifted_index and convective_inhibition requirements as an exact ICON-EU profile. Absence of proof is treated fail-closed.
The documented JSON forecast response schema has no model or upstream-source field, so the current JSON artifact and inspector cannot prove which model produced the bytes.
The structural inspector validates only non-null values and therefore permits an entire requested variable axis to be null, which cannot prove model-variable support.
The immutable attribution policy credits Open-Meteo but explicitly marks upstream_model_credit_resolution_required as true.

The official FlatBuffers schema can expose a per-response model enum, but adopting it would replace the current native JSON product and requires a separately pinned schema, decoder, model enum check and recovery contract. It is not evidence for the current JSON capture.

minimum_remediation_before_reevaluation: define a fixed model selector and a canonical numeric coverage authority that contains every admitted target
pin a model-specific variable and temporal-resolution profile with no unsupported or mixed-model fields
bind the selected model enum and upstream source credit into the query authority, native request, raw receipt and capture receipt
if FlatBuffers is selected, introduce and audit a new exact-raw product contract with pinned schema identity
only after the model gate closes, atomically prove the parent-held one-shot usage permit, crash recovery, capacity, activation, terminal raw audit and privacy gates
